scope: Sanitized fictional aggregate evidence only; no raw feedback, private notes, tokens, or authored source. Experiments have different boundaries and must not be added as provider usage.

static_skills.scope: Static repository skill files, including frontmatter; linked files are optional and not evidence they were loaded. Runtime traces recorded separately.

autonomous_hosted_baseline_editor.measurement_scope: This editor’s actual RecordedPeer HTTP MCP calls only; coordinator and browser personas excluded. Phases prefixed editor-.

provider_usage.reason: No supported provider/harness usage metadata was exposed to this role.

transport.overlap_notice: Response text, image base64 and complete serialized response sizes overlap; do not add them. Bytes are not tokens.

timing.interpretation: Event wall time includes model work, tools, review waits and coordination; summed RPC duration is not user-task elapsed time. Final-review wait continues.

errors.description: Referenced design is not granted to artifact-scoped connection; honored denial.
Held old guard rejected after owner note; fresh read and focused HTML merge preserved note.
Schema lacks maximum; runtime rejects limit=12. Captured pages of 8 and 4.

limitations: One autonomous observation, not a controlled performance or token comparison.
Capture metadata reports runtime_matches_deck=false; real UI Present/export remains separate.
Narrow fitted preview readability concern came from accessible Shared context; editor did not drive human browser.
No production code edits, no Store/API source bypass, no human/private draft inspection.
No JavaScript interaction was needed by this composition; arbitrary HTML/CSS/inline SVG and built-in animation remained freely authored.

cli_experiment.comparison: Interface bytes, not billed tokens. Source must initially be authored in either flow. CLI shifts subsequent transport to local files; ordinary inline comparison uses the identical prepared write arguments and successful receipt, not a second write.

visual_evidence.scope: 1600x900 real audience captures, fictional authored content; no new templates or app chrome changes

fresh_local_agent.scope: Independent tool discoverability task; recorded request/result objects only. Notifications and shell/browser context are not fully instrumented; not comparable to the full hosted authoring trace.
fresh_local_agent.initialization_note: One sandbox-denied attempt; two initialized processes after accidental stdin closure; one catalogue read reused.
results: Canonical discovery, general reply, bounded read and append found without old tool-name hints.
Custom HTML/CSS/SVG and interactive HTML/JavaScript saved with original notes/metadata.
Existing live client selected over file CLI for a small payload.
limitations: Local bundled browser missing; no visual verification claimed by this agent.
Hosted browser personas and captures supply separate visual checks.
No provider usage or token estimates available.

source.note: Autonomous fixture started after corrected capture bounds; final canonical unknown-design error wording was subsequently checked in the matched source benchmark. That unused error path does not change these exercised operations.

scenario.payload_origin: Own baseline authored payloads, reauthored through live scoped MCP; no canonical state/history copied.

autonomous_hosted_candidate_editor.measurement_scope: Candidate editor-* RecordedPeer MCP phases only; coordinator preflight and browser persona calls excluded.

provider_usage.reason: No supported provider/harness usage metadata exposed to this role.

timing.interpretation: Wall time includes source reuse, coordination and review waits. Summed RPC time is not user task elapsed time.

correctness.description: Proactive stale UI disabled Send; explicit Review → Use this version → Send succeeded. No forced 409 required. Editor received only final released request5.

limitations: This rerun reused reviewed source and prior learning; it is not comparable to first-draft baseline as a token, speed or cost experiment.
Candidate adds all-slide source verification and append/idempotency checks; autonomous call workloads differ.

Narrow fitted view remains a small overview; owner/reviewer UI evidence is separate.
